text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening position and closing restatement","quality":"organization","description":"The essay has a recognizable argumentative structure with an introduction, body paragraphs, and a conclusion that returns to the claim."},{"evidence":"“First… Next… Also… Many people…”","quality":"coherence","description":"The essay moves through its points in an orderly sequence, making the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"mentions fuel savings, safety, alerts, and accidents","quality":"supportive development","description":"The essay develops several reasons for its position rather than relying on a single unsupported claim."},{"evidence":"“Many people have reason to believe… Although this is a major concern”","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges opposing concerns and answers them instead of ignoring the other side."},{"evidence":"“save time, money, fuel, and even lives”","quality":"persuasive emphasis","description":"The essay ends with a forceful summary of benefits that reinforces its main argument."}]}
